request.text: The Outer Berms. Factories to the horizon, once. Now it's their bones, and whatever still walks about inside them. There are secrets under that scrap. Few go looking, and fewer come home. So don't go out in just a shirt. Mira sells a vest and boots. Better plate, you build.
